name: spike-sqlite-fts-reference
description: Off-device reference for task 0.2's search half. Runs the same corpus, the same two index implementations, and the same grading as the on-device probe, against node:sqlite — whose bundled SQLite is built with FTS5 at a version within one patch of the amalgamation expo-sqlite vendors. Answers everything about FTS5 semantics without a phone; the shipped-binary question still needs one.
